verses.text: So, my child, be strengthened by the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Pass on to reliable people what you heard from me in front of many witnesses, so they'll be able to teach others too.
Share in suffering like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
No soldier on duty gets tangled up in everyday affairs. They want to please the one who enlisted them.
An athlete doesn't win the prize unless they compete according to the rules.
The farmer who works hard should be the first to enjoy a share of the harvest.
Think about what I'm saying. The Lord will help you understand it all.
Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is the Good News I preach,
and for it I'm suffering—even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God's word can't be chained.
So I endure everything for the sake of God's chosen people, so they too may receive salvation in Christ Jesus and eternal glory.
This saying is trustworthy: ‘If we died with him, we'll also live with him.
If we endure, we'll also reign with him. If we disown him, he'll disown us.
If we're unfaithful, he remains faithful, because he can't deny who he is.’
Remind people of these things, and charge them before the Lord not to fight over words. It does no good and ruins those who listen.
Do your best to present yourself to God as someone approved, a worker who has no reason to be ashamed and who handles the word of truth correctly.
Avoid empty, irreverent talk, because it leads people further into godlessness.
Such talk spreads like gangrene. Hymenaeus and Philetus are examples.
They've wandered away from the truth, claiming the resurrection has already happened, and they're upsetting the faith of some.
Even so, God's firm foundation stands, marked with this seal: ‘The Lord knows those who belong to him,’ and ‘Everyone who names the Lord must turn away from evil.’
In a large house there are dishes not only of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some are for special use, others for ordinary use.
Anyone who cleanses themselves from what is dishonorable will be like a special-use dish, set apart, useful to the Master, and ready for every good work.
Run from youthful passions. Pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord with pure hearts.
Don't get involved in foolish, ignorant arguments. You know they lead to fights.
The Lord's servant must not fight. Instead, be kind to everyone, able to teach, and patient.
Gently correct those who oppose you. God may give them a change of heart so they can know the truth.
Then they may come to their senses and escape the devil's trap, after being captured by him to do his will.
